{{Quote|Various records note that the first Matukai was a human female from the world of Karvoss II who discovered her ability to touch the Force while practicing a form of meditative martial arts.|[[Tionne Solusar]], ''[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force]]''|<ref name="JvS">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>}}
The '''Parmorak sector''' was situated in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Karvoss II]]. The latter was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of a [[Unidentified Human female (Matukai)|Human female]] who founded the [[Matukai/Legends|Matukai]] sect of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-users]] at some point following the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]].

Four [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]] later, the Parmorak [[Sector/Legends|sector]] was governed by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Chorkun]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Chorkun was eventually eliminated by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] agent [[Kassar Kosciusko]]. Karvoss II was visited by Alliance [[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] by the [[Time/Legends|time]] the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] was fought. On his way to the [[Wedding of Moff Nile Owen's daughter|wedding]] of Moff [[Nile Owen's daughter]], Cracken met the Rebel [[Saboteur/Legends|saboteur]] [[Aimi Loto]] on the planet.

==Description==
The Parmorak [[Sector/Legends|sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> was located in the [[Southern Core]] portion of<ref name="TEA Karvoss" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. It contained the [[Karvoss system/Legends|Karvoss system]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] carried out operations in the Parmorak sector,<ref name="RECG">''[[Rebellion Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref> which was governed by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Chorkun]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. In a highly publicized incident, the Moff was mysteriously eliminated by the [[Tarro]] [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] agent [[Kassar Kosciusko]], who occasionally used his skills as a former [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] to prevent information leaks and other security breaches.<ref name="CRO" />

==Locations==
{{Quote|I first met Aimi when my R2 unit malfunctioned on Karvoss II.|Personal addendum by Airen Cracken to a [[Datafile/Legends|datafile]] detailing Rebel Alliance [[operative]]s|<ref name="CRO" />}}
The Karvoss [[Star system/Legends|system]]<ref name="EAOC" /> was home to the terrestrial<ref name="CRO" /> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Karvoss II]].<ref name="JvS" /> After the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]]<ref name="JATM">''[[Jedi Academy Training Manual]]''</ref> of [[3996 BBY]], a [[Unidentified Human female (Matukai)|Human female]] from Karvoss II discovered her [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitivity]] while practicing a [[Unidentified martial arts form|form]] of [[Unarmed combat/Legends|martial arts]]. She eventually went on to create the [[Matukai/Legends|Matukai]] sect of Force-users.<ref name="JvS" />

While on a mission to facilitate the defection of the [[Nile Owen's personal assistant|personal assistant]] of Moff [[Nile Owen]] during the [[Wedding of Moff Nile Owen's daughter|wedding]] of [[Nile Owen's daughter|Owen's daughter]] by the [[Time/Legends|time]] the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] was fought, Rebel Alliance [[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] visited Karvoss II. There he met the Rebel [[Saboteur/Legends|saboteur]] [[Aimi Loto]], who was posing as an itinerant [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Technician/Legends|maintenance specialist]]. Loto subsequently warned Cracken to be wary of the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droids]] present at the wedding celebration, for she had secretly sabotaged them.<ref name="CRO" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Parmorak sector was created by [[Craig Robert Carey]] and [[J. Michael Denbo]], and was introduced in ''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]'', a [[1994]] [[West End Games]] sourcebook published for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="CRO" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the sector's Karvoss system in grid square M-12.<ref name="TEA Karvoss" />
